plate.cravingSub: Add your foods. Chef Mealan sets the amounts.
plate.cravingHint: Finds dishes in your recipes, Coach's, the members' and Chef Mealan's, and your foods. Add PD 7+ to keep only dishes at PD 7 or more.
plate.fromMyRecipes: From My recipes. Change what you like, then Fit to my target or Keep it as it is.
plate.amountChef: Chef Mealan can change this amount.
plate.underPortion: {grams} g is under a portion of {food}, {min} to {max} g.
plate.swipe: Swipe a food left to swap it, right to remove it.
plate.addOneFirst: Add one food first. Chef Mealan builds the {meal} around it.
plate.oldHelp: Ate it saves it to {day}, to the meal it was set for, at the time it was started. Save for later keeps it to finish another time, and the Plate is free. Keep working on it opens it as it is, and this plate is not asked about again. Clear it empties the plate.
plate.oldHelpPhoto: Ate it saves it to {day}, to the meal it was set for, at the photo's time. Save for later keeps it to finish another time, and the Plate is free. Keep working on it opens it as it is, and this plate is not asked about again. Clear it empties the plate.
plate.cookAskHelp: Whichever you pick, {dish} then starts on its own plate. Cancel goes back to the recipe.
plate.saveMineHelp: Save my plate for later keeps it to finish another time; it waits at the top of the Plate. Clear my plate empties it. Cancel goes back to the recipe.
plate.addOrNewHelp: Add to my plate: the new foods join yours, and the plate keeps its name. Start a new plate: only the new foods.
plate.addOrNewHelpPhoto: Add to my plate: the new foods join yours, marked ~, and the plate keeps its name. Start a new plate: only the new foods.
today.setYourTrainingWeekAnd: Set your Training week, and Chef Mealan won't need to ask ›
today.nothingPlannedOrEatenYet: Nothing planned or eaten yet today
today.pickOneOfYourMeals: Pick one of your meals, or make one on the Plate.
today.setTheDaySMeals: Set the day's meals, and they wait here
today.yourAnswerClosesTheCook: Your answer closes the cook: the strip goes, the card keeps it all.
today.seeTheDayAgainstIts: See the day against its plan
today.justForYouItStays: Just for you: it stays on this card and with the recipe's photos. Members never see it unless you pick it when sharing.
today.whyOneTapIsEnough: Why? One tap is enough; a line is extra.
today.changedForTodayOnlyYour: Changed for today only. Your Training week stays the same.
today.ifTodayGoesDifferentlyTap: If today goes differently, tap the pencil. The numbers follow, the Training week stays.
today.noKindOfDayWas: No kind of day was set
today.opensThePageInExplorer: Opens the page in Explorer, with your case.
today.left: About {kcal} kcal and {protein} g protein left for today.

today.atKcal.text: You are at your day's kcal. A light {meal} keeps you there.

dayedit.lightMeansYouCouldChat: Light means you could chat while doing it. Hard means you couldn't.
dayedit.optionalPlanShowsAClock: Optional. Plan shows a clock time only when you set one.
dayedit.nothingPlannedAWalkOr: Nothing planned. A walk or yoga is an activity; pick it instead.
dayedit.noTrainingYourWorkAnd: No training. Your work and your steps still count.
measured.logEveryMealAndWeigh: Log every meal, and weigh in most mornings.
measured.theAverageOfYourFull: The average of your full days: every planned meal eaten, swapped or skipped on purpose, and anything extra logged. Days with a meal missing don't count.
measured.whatYouAtePlusKcal: What you ate, plus 7,700 kcal for each kg the line went down, or minus for each kg it went up, spread over the 14 days.
measured.itGoesOnWithThe: It goes on with the last 14 days until it is ready.
measured.yourNumbersStayAsThey: Your numbers stay as they are until you choose. This card keeps updating from your last 14 days.
plan.thisDateOnlyYourTraining: This date only. Your Training week stays the same.
plan.nothingWasLoggedOnThis: Nothing was logged on this day.

plan.aDayBeforeTodayIs.text: A day before today is what you ate: it counts at its meal's time. Nothing to make, no rating asked.

plan.tapAFoodOnceWhen: Tap a food once when it is in the basket, twice for not this time.
plan.thePlanChangedSinceThis: The plan changed since this list was made
plan.createANewMealOn: Create a new meal on the Plate
plan.changeTheTrainingForThis: Change the training for this date
plan.addASnackOrMake: Add a snack, or make the portions bigger.
plan.makeThePortionsSmallerOr: Make the portions smaller, or swap a meal.
plan.thisDayOnlyNoRecipe: This day only. No recipe stands behind it.
plan.tapAMealToPut: Tap a meal to put it in this slot.
calendar.aSlotWithAMeal: A slot with a meal on Plan goes in; an open slot stays out. Plan a meal, and it shows within seconds.
calendar.chefMealanWritesYourPlan: Chef Mealan writes your plan into a calendar of its own, called Chef Mealan, in your Google Calendar. It never reads or changes your other events.
calendar.eachKindIsOnOr: Each kind is on or off. Change it any time.
calendar.theNameTheTimeAnd: The name, the time, and a link that opens that day on Plan. Never kcal, protein, your goal or anything about your health. Calendars get shared with family and colleagues, so the numbers stay in the app.
calendar.googleAsksYouOnceFor: Google asks you once for one right: to create the Chef Mealan calendar and manage the events in it. Nothing else. You can take it back in your Google account at any time.
calendar.chefMealanStopsWritingWhat: Chef Mealan stops writing. What about the calendar?
calendar.deletingYourAccountAlsoRemoves: Deleting your account also removes the Chef Mealan calendar.
calendar.fromYourCalendarToThe: From your calendar to the app
calendar.busyAndFreeTimesOnly: Busy and free times only. Never the titles, the people or the places of your events.
calendar.withItPlanSuggestsA: With it, Plan suggests: a meal moved out of a meeting, a quick dinner after a late evening, a meal to carry on a full day, and asks when training sits in a busy block. It suggests; your times change only when you tap.
calendar.aChefMealanMealYou: A Chef Mealan meal you move in Google Calendar, on the same day, takes that time here too.
calendar.breakfastLunchDinnerAtYour: Breakfast, lunch, dinner at your times
calendar.cookDinnerMinutesBeforeWhen: Cook dinner, 30 minutes before, when the planned meal has steps
calendar.yourTrainingDaysAtTheir: Your training days, at their time
calendar.chefMealanStoppedWritingAnd: Chef Mealan stopped writing, and the calendar is removed from Google.
calendar.chefMealanStoppedWritingThe: Chef Mealan stopped writing. The calendar stays in Google as it is.
calendar.bringingGoogleCalendarUpTo: Bringing Google Calendar up to date…
plan.heldInSlot: {dish} is in this slot. Tap another meal to swap it.
recipes.fromALinkOrScreenshots: From a link or screenshots, as on the Plate. It goes into My recipes; nothing goes on the Plate.
recipes.nothingHereYetAddOne: Nothing here yet. Add one above, or make your first on the Plate.
recipes.nothingSharedYetARecipe: Nothing shared yet. A recipe of yours can be the first: open it, then Share with members.
recipes.nothingMatchesClearAFilter: Nothing matches. Clear a filter or the search.
recipes.makeItPutsItOn: Make it puts it on the Plate when you want to cook it.
recipes.anIdeaFromAPhoto: An idea from a photo, not made yet
recipes.noPictureCameBackTry: No picture came back. Try again.
recipe.yourPhotoFromTodayIs: Your photo from today is the cover. When you share with members, you choose which photo they see.
recipe.cookedAsWrittenPlanCounts: Cooked as written. Plan counts it in these, and each meal takes as many as it needs. Empty: the Plate divides it by weight.
recipe.partsGiveAFoodIts: Parts: give a food its part, or make it optional. Optional foods stay out of the numbers.
recipe.noAFoodOfIts: No, a food of its own
recipe.noFoodWithThatName: No food with that name. Foods come from Foods in the menu, or a scan on the Plate.
recipe.theRecipeSNumbersLeave: The recipe's numbers leave them out, and so do ours. Make it, and add any of them on the plate.
recipe.savedForLaterOnThe: Saved for later on the Plate
recipe.eachStepSaysHowIt: Each step says how it relates to the original.
recipe.writeTheStepsForMy: Write the steps for my dish
recipe.theOriginalWorksWithYour: The original works with your foods as they are.
recipe.noStepsYetEditRecipe: No steps yet. Edit recipe adds them.
recipe.liveOnChefmealanComThe: Live on chefmealan.com: the live page changes only with Change live page.
recipe.onThePlateChangeFoods: On the Plate: change foods, or Fit to my target sets today's amounts. Then Make. The recipe stays as it is.
recipe.changeTheRecipeItselfThe: Change the recipe itself: the foods, the grams, the steps.
recipe.yourScreenshotsForYouOnly: Your screenshots, for you only. Never the cover, never shared with members, never published.
recipe.chefMealanIsWritingThe: Chef Mealan is writing the steps
recipe.chefMealanCouldNotAnswer: Chef Mealan could not answer. Try again.
recipe.drawOneTomorrowOrAdd: Draw one tomorrow, or add your own photo now.
recipe.yourOwnPhotoIsAlways: Your own photo is always better.
recipe.thisPhotoIsTheCover: This photo is the cover. × deletes it.
recipe.theFirstPhotoIsThe: The first photo is the cover. Tap a photo to move it with ‹ ›; × deletes it.
recipe.oneOfTheTwoHas: One of the two has no energy on its label, so only the weight can match.
recipe.theSameFoodRawOr: The same food, raw or cooked: the same energy keeps the recipe as it was.
recipe.draftedByChefMealanFrom: Drafted by Chef Mealan from your foods and amounts. Read it, change any word.
recipe.asTheOriginalWritesThem: As the original writes them, for the whole recipe.
recipe.theNumbersAboveFollowAs: The numbers above follow as you type.
recipe.cookItNowTheRecipe: Cook it now: the recipe goes on the Plate, Fit to my target sets today's amounts. The recipe stays as it is.
recipe.theLinkSaysThisRecipe: The link says this recipe was taken down.
recipe.notOnTheSiteYet: Not on the site yet. Publishing gives the recipe its own page and link.
recipe.whereItCameFromIsn: Where it came from isn't known yet
publish.anyoneWithTheLinkSees: Anyone with the link sees the page now.
publish.name: Name
publish.theFoodsAsThePage: The foods, as the page names them
publish.chefMealanLeftOutThe: Chef Mealan left out the brands; change a name if you like. It changes only the page.
publish.theStepsStayWithThe: The steps stay with the recipe in the app too.
publish.someFoodsHaveNoEnergy: Some foods have no energy or protein value: add them before publishing
publish.thePageSaysFromThe: The page says From the kitchen. Off, it says On paper: calculated, not cooked yet.
publish.thinSoftAndTheyRoll: Thin, soft, and they roll without breaking.
publish.theLinkSaysThisRecipe: The link says this recipe was taken down. Publish again brings it back on the same link.
publish.savedAsYouTypeOnly: Saved as you type, only here. Close it any time and come back.
publish.theLivePageShowsThe: The live page shows the version before.
publish.theRecipeSPhotosThe: The recipe's photos, the cover first, then the plate photos from its cards. The one with the blue frame leads, on the page and on the images. An uploaded photo is kept with the recipe.
publish.uploadAPhotoOfThe: Upload a photo of the plate; the photo is kept with the recipe. Without one the page shows no photo.
publish.noRatingYetRateIt: No rating yet: rate it on the Plate to show DaaM good
publish.theLivePageChangesWhen: The live page changes when you publish.
members.takeItBackRemovesIt: Take it back removes it from Members; members who kept a copy keep theirs.
members.membersSeeTheCoverThe: Members see the cover, the foods, the amounts and the steps, calculated for their own day. Never your notes or your ratings.
members.yourPlatePhotosStayYours: Your plate photos stay yours unless you pick one here.
members.sureItGoesForEvery: Sure? It goes for every member
members.membersRecipesEachAsThe: Members' recipes, each as the whole recipe: your day is planned in full. Make it puts your portion on the Plate.
members.membersRecipesSetYourGoal: Members' recipes. Set your goal and every recipe shows your portion.
members.thatNameDidnTWork: That name didn't work. Try another.
members.oneNamePerMemberSo: One name per member, so members find all your recipes under it.
steppics.itShowsThisStepAnd: It shows this step, and only this step
steppics.everyFoodIsFromThe: Every food is from the recipe, and where it should be by now
steppics.meatRawBeforeCookingCooked: Meat raw before cooking, cooked through after it
steppics.theAmountsLookLikeThe: The amounts look like the grams
steppics.aRealCookWouldDo: A real cook would do it this way
steppics.drawnByAiSaysSo: Drawn by AI says so under the picture, in cook mode and in Watch the steps. The step's words and amounts stay what counts.
steppics.yourPicturesStayWithYour: Your pictures stay with your recipe, only you can open them. Not shared with members in Beta.
steppics.madeOnYourPhoneFrom: Made on your phone from the step pictures: no video file.
delrecipe.itCouldnTBeDeleted: It couldn't be deleted. Try again.
recipein.aRecipePageFromA: A recipe page from a website. Instagram and TikTok links need a login, so they don't open for us: use Screenshot there.
recipein.theLinkStaysWithThe: The link stays with the recipe, so you can always go back to the original.
recipein.thisLinkDidnTOpen: This link didn't open for us.
recipein.thisDoesnTLookLike: This doesn't look like a recipe.
yourcooks.eachTimeYouCookIt: Each time you cook it, the cook keeps the photos and the answers. The best photo of a step can become the step's photo here.
yourcooks.onlyYouSeeThisYour: Only you see this. Your coach sees a meal you share.
